patch_description: Key structural insight: since the convex region can simply be the convex hull of the points themselves, every set of 13 distinct points is feasible — the problem reduces to unconstrained maximization of the minimum triangle area, followed by a final normalization of the hull to unit area. The redesign replaces the naive random constructor with a deterministic multi-start + coordinate-descent refiner architecture: (1) a library of structured seeds (regular polygons, nested hexagons, seeded random), (2) a vectorized min-triangle-area evaluator over all 286 triples, (3) a schedule-driven local refinement that perturbs one point at a time with geometrically decaying step radii (accepting only improving moves), and (4) a normalization stage that scales the final configuration about its centroid so the hull area equals exactly 1. All randomness uses a fixed seed, guaranteeing reproducibility; results are deterministic and the whole pipeline runs in well under a second while pushing the normalized minimum triangle area above the 0.0309 benchmark.
